name: Heartswood Core
summary: Warlocks in Stormwind City use the Heartswood Core to summon a succubus. Gakin the Darkbinder provides the enchanted ritual focus, crafted from an ancient tree’s wood, to pierce the Twisting Nether and draw the demon into an arcane summoning circle.

sections.title: A Focus for the Nether
sections.body: Beneath the Slaughtered Lamb in Stormwind’s Mage Quarter, warlocks perform rites beyond the city watch’s gaze. The Heartswood Core channels the magic needed to begin a binding ritual. Crafted from the wood of an ancient tree, it holds enough lingering magic to pierce the veil between worlds. At a consecrated summoning circle, an initiate focuses dark arts through the core and opens a passage to the Twisting Nether, drawing a succubus across the divide.

sections.title: The Trial of Binding
sections.body: A warlock who summons a demon must still prove dominance over its cunning and seductive nature to control it. Gakin gives the Heartswood Core to promising practitioners so they can face the summoned demon in combat. Succubi prey on weakness and can overwhelm feeble minds, making the encounter a deadly rite of passage. The aspiring warlock must subdue the fiend and return the spent core to Gakin to prove their will is strong enough to bind the servant permanently.

faq.q: What is the Heartswood Core used for?
faq.answer: Warlocks use the Heartswood Core at the summoning circle beneath the Slaughtered Lamb to open a portal to the Twisting Nether and draw a succubus into our realm. You must fight and bind the summoned demon.

aliases: where do i get heartswood core
faq.answer: Gakin the Darkbinder, a master warlock, provides the Heartswood Core and trains novices in the hidden catacombs beneath the Slaughtered Lamb in Stormwind’s Mage Quarter.

faq.q: Where must the core be used?
faq.answer: Use the core at the summoning circle in the crypts beneath the Slaughtered Lamb, deep below Stormwind’s streets.

faq.q: What happens after the ritual is finished?
aliases: what do i do after summoning
faq.answer: After you summon the succubus, defeat it in combat and send it back to the void. Then return the Heartswood Core to Gakin the Darkbinder to learn how to command the demon at will.

angles.text: As an Alliance warlock, you use the Heartswood Core as an essential training relic to summon and master your first succubus.
